title: Main Menu
summary: Central entry point of DayPass: install or update packages first, then open the network, proxy, hardware and maintenance menus.

items.title: Install Package Profile
items.description: Starts the installer flow: pick Passwall-1 or Passwall-2, then choose Recommended or Custom mode.
items.usage_tip: Run this first on a fresh router. Recommended mode is the safest choice.

items.title: Check & Update Packages
items.description: Refreshes and upgrades the packages DayPass installed from its own package source.
items.usage_tip: Use it after a new DayPass release or when a proxy engine stops working.

items.title: Network Settings
items.description: Opens the network module: home Wi-Fi AP, guest network, LAN IP, multi-WAN, live speed and DNS.
items.usage_tip: Start here when clients cannot connect or when you need a guest SSID.

items.title: Proxy & Routing Manager
items.description: Opens the proxy module: nodes, subscriptions, routing rules, balancing, health checks and Clean IP.
items.usage_tip: Everything about Passwall is managed from this menu.

items.title: System Resources & Hardware Info
items.description: Shows a read-only summary of architecture, OpenWrt version, package manager, RAM and storage usage.
items.usage_tip: Check free storage before installing heavy proxy engines.

items.title: Maintenance & Recovery
items.description: Purge DayPass packages, clear caches, back up the system configuration or factory reset the router.
items.usage_tip: Take a backup before making large changes.

items.title: Help & Manuals
items.description: Opens the manual index. The same index also opens when you press h on this screen.
items.usage_tip: On any other menu, h opens that screen's own manual.

items.title: Exit
items.description: Closes the DayPass session without changing anything.
items.usage_tip: Safe to use at any time.
